author: Spartemex
body:
So, this team was CrookArmy with 29 members, but I woke up one day, and found it with 4 members and me as the leader. So, I am trying to reboot as basically the same thing as before! We will have lots of scrimmages just to have fun and play! Pretty much anyone can join, although we have strict trolling rules on the Scrim Servers. Just don't do it.

So if you want to join, send me a skype message (Spartemex), or track me down in game! :)
